name: Ha Long sea-mussel porridge
summary: Cháo trai Hạ Long is porridge from ground rice and sea mussels, not the river mussels of the Hanoi bowl. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, says it comes with green onion, cilantro, fried shallot, and quẩy.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, contrasts it with the freshwater cháo trai of Hanoi.
howToEat: Ground rice cooked with trai biển. Eat it with hành lá, mùi tàu, hành khô, and quẩy.
VnExpress printed about 15,000–20,000 đồng a bowl with the quẩy, at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2. A current price is Check on arrival. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Hạ Long 1 and chợ Hạ Long 2.
